# Media policy fixtures

The tiny legacy Office fixtures are unmodified Apache POI test files, distributed under the Apache License 2.0:

- `legacy-real.doc`: [`simple.doc`](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/trunk/test-data/document/simple.doc), SHA-256 `4876E828E62D490FA188C7C4E47013E2E0DFDF02F5903DFD374BC0D2B2049CA1`
- `legacy-real.xls`: [`SimpleWithColours.xls`](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/trunk/test-data/spreadsheet/SimpleWithColours.xls), SHA-256 `0AD0C5D289605AA78E996E480820C7C7C2B256D448C52EA6665436A1F7FFF984`
- `legacy-real.ppt`: [`Single_Coloured_Page.ppt`](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/trunk/test-data/slideshow/Single_Coloured_Page.ppt), SHA-256 `AD93681349166235F7B31D3A484675A50F96BB5D375AED27BAC1F8EACEFB5CCD`
- `legacy-macro.doc`: [`SimpleMacro.doc`](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/trunk/test-data/document/SimpleMacro.doc), SHA-256 `39E9608C711D38F298ED20A5BFAE12FCDAED6F4BE2BE4D26DB670475216CA393`

The ZIP package fixtures were generated locally from the minimal XML parts needed by each behavioral test.
